title: Abused kitty with two broken legs rescued from the trash...WATCH THE HAPPY END !
description:
Someone sobbing on the phone… THEY FOUND GOLDIE IN THE TRASH, WITH FRACTURES IN BOTH HER BACK LEGS!
The injuries to his legs are terrible, skin and muscle torn, exposing tendons and broken bones. We estimate that he has been like this for at least a week.
A week of suffering and agony.
Goldie is wonderful. He lets us touch and examine him without complaint. A weak meow tells us that he’s had enough and we sedate him in order to be able to treat his wounds.
THE FRACTURES ARE TERRIBLE, BUT…. WE HOPE TO BE ABLE TO SAVE BOTH LEGS...
I wrote this one and a half years ago... THIS IS HOW THE STORY ENDS!
